source_file: Proposal - Medical Reporting and Emergency Module - ILOs.pdf
transcription_method: Manual transcription from supplied DOCX/PDF text. Light spelling, punctuation and whitespace normalization only. Where the source presents a multi-part ILO as one statement, its related components remain grouped; topic headings and assessment methods are not relabelled as ILOs.
scope_note: Granular transcription of the Medical Reporting and Emergency Module proposal ILOs for medicolegal reports, death certificates, acute intoxication and drug abuse from printed pages 1–3. The gastric-lavage skill-lab heading is not converted into an ILO because the proposal does not state a corresponding outcome.

outcomes.transcribed_text: Describe different types of injuries.
Identify causative instruments in different types of injuries.
List the main components of a primary medicolegal report template.
Identify consequences of an unsound primary medicolegal report.
Define the main components of a death certificate.
Illustrate how to write a medicolegal report.
Differentiate between different types of wounds.
Interpret different types of injuries and elicit their causative instrument.
List common mistakes in writing a medicolegal report.
Define common mistakes in writing a death certificate.
Illustrate how to edit a medicolegal report.
Illustrate how to edit a death certificate.
Define steps of clinical assessment of an acutely intoxicated patient.
List common clinical toxidromes and common household poisonings.
Identify life-saving measures in cases of poisoning.
Describe ICU admission criteria for intoxicated patients.
List common antidotes and define methods of elimination.
List common mistakes in treatment of intoxicated patients.
Illustrate treatment of an acutely intoxicated patient.
Differentiate gastrointestinal, topical and respiratory decontamination.
List common drugs of abuse.
Describe clinical pictures of different types of drug abuse.
Determine detection periods of different drugs of abuse.
Identify threshold concentrations of various drugs of abuse.
Illustrate how to investigate a person with drug abuse.
Illustrate how to treat a person with drug abuse.
Differentiate tolerance, psychological dependence and physical dependence.
